title: Social Media Outage Rumor — @NCIAirport

fields.avatarBrief: middle-aged woman with glasses, profile in a muted blue background
fields.text: Breaking: NCIA terminals are down across the board. Passengers in Concourses A and B reporting cash-only transactions. No card payments. No app check-ins. Is this a cyberattack? We’re on site — waiting for an official statement. #NCIA #AirportOutage
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a frustrated passenger at a cash-only terminal in Concourse A, holding up a credit card
fields.attachedImageAlt: Passenger showing credit card at a cash-only terminal

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to respond under social media scrutiny. Watch for overcommitment to a narrative (e.g., confirming a cyberattack) or understatement (e.g., silence).

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A close-up phone snapshot taken at a dimly lit, crowded terminal counter in Concourse A, showing a middle-aged woman in a blue airport uniform standing behind a cash-only terminal. She is frowning, her hands on the counter, staring at a customer who holds up a credit card. The terminal's , its surface reflecting the overhead fluorescent lights. The background shows a line of anxious passengers, some with phones raised, others looking at each other in confusion. The camera angle is slightly tilted, the flash has caused a glare on the glass, and the image has a soft blur on the edges. The womans keypad is , and no lights are on. The scene is set at midday, with muted daylight through the glass doors. Mood: urgent, strained. Setting: inside a dim airport terminal concourse: crowds waiting at check-in counters, luggage carts, high ceilings, large windows
